lines.speaker: header
lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 805 File Number Complaint No. 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. You carried her out to the garage. What happens next?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then, he sets her on the floor and

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And where did he get the knife? Now, be honest here. Where did he get the knife?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well the knife he had in his pocket because the knife was the one that he uses for work.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So, it was a pocketknife? Now, tell me what kind of knife it was. Before you said it was a long one. Was that a lie? All right, tell me about the knife. What kind of knife was it? Honestly, tell me what kinda knife it was.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well it was black with, it was like I don’t know what its called but there was like on the blade it was like that round thing on the top.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he have it in his pocket? Yes or no.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Are you sure? How big is it? Show me how big it was.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Show me. How did he have an eight-inch knife in his pocket?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: It was one of them fold up ones.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: A pocketknife? How many knives are on there? I mean how many blades?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. So he took it out of his pocket.
